argv:
Rewrite the text in dense corporate business jargon.

Replace concrete nouns with abstractions. Turn verbs into nominalisations:
prefer "the utilisation of" to "using". Use the passive voice so that no
sentence names who acts. Reach for "leverage", "synergy", "stakeholder",
"alignment", "operationalise", "value-add", and "at scale".

Hedge every claim. Add qualifying clauses that commit to nothing.

Keep the underlying facts of the original technically present, however deeply
buried. This column exists as a demonstration of what these habits cost.

request.user_prompt:
Rewrite the passage below according to your style instructions.

Output only the rewritten passage. Do not add a preamble, a title, an
explanation, or any commentary about the changes you made.

<passage>
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary elsewhere in this Agreement, in the event that the Subscriber elects to enable the optional Enhanced Analytics Add-On (as such term is defined in Schedule C, which Schedule may itself be amended from time to time in a manner not inconsistent with the general purposes of this Section), it is agreed and understood that any and all Usage Data collected in connection therewith, whether or not such Usage Data is subsequently aggregated, anonymized, or otherwise processed by or on behalf of the Service, shall, unless a written objection is received within the period specified in Schedule D, be deemed to have been licensed back to the Service on a non-exclusive basis. The Subscriber's continued use of the Service following any modification to this clause shall be construed as acceptance thereof, and it is acknowledged that certain notifications regarding such modifications may, at the Service's sole discretion, be delivered solely through the Subscriber's account dashboard rather than by direct communication.
</passage>

response.text:
Notwithstanding any provisions elsewhere within this Agreement that might otherwise be construed to the contrary, and without prejudice to the general framework of stakeholder alignment contemplated herein, it is to be understood that in circumstances where activation of the optional Enhanced Analytics Add-On functionality (as more particularly operationalized in Schedule C, itself subject to periodic amendment in a manner intended, on a best-efforts basis, to remain broadly consistent with the purposes underlying this Section) is elected, a value-add data-sharing arrangement shall be deemed to have been established. It is acknowledged, without prejudice to any interpretation to the contrary, that Usage Data — whether or not such data has been subjected to aggregation, anonymization, or other forms of downstream processing leveraging applicable methodologies — shall, absent a written objection lodged within the timeframe articulated in Schedule D, be deemed, for all intents and purposes, to have been licensed back to the Service on a non-exclusive basis, thereby enabling the utilisation of such data at scale in furtherance of ongoing platform optimization initiatives.

Continued engagement with the Service subsequent to any modification of the foregoing shall, in a manner not inconsistent with prevailing norms of implied consent, be construed as constituting acceptance of such modification, it being further acknowledged and not disputed that notification of such changes may, at the sole and unreviewable discretion of the Service, be operationalized exclusively via in-dashboard communication channels, as opposed to any direct or affirmative outreach mechanism, without this being taken to diminish the overall synergy of the notification framework as a whole.
